verdict.rationale: LocalAI's web UI and CLI let power-users manage downloaded models (gallery/Discover page, `local-ai models list`, aliasing) and per-model configs (PRELOAD_MODELS, external backends), and the chat UI supports editing saved messages, but there is no evidence of a dedicated saved-prompts library or a single unified pane combining models+prompts+configs. Missing for 10: explicit saved-prompt management feature, unified UI screenshot/doc showing models+prompts+configs together, independent corroboration of this workflow.
